description: The edge a list would have sprouted next: `export =` is the same node kind as `export default`, and its value is a function written right there, so the rule binds it and the body is enforced. It is not keyed `default` — a consumer names the module itself — so the diagnostics never call it the default export.

diagnostics.message: `@nothrow` binds to nothing on the `export =` assignment: a mark is a claim about a body, and the value here is not a function written at this declaration. Mark the function where its body is written, or — if that body is not yours — assert its color in `nothrow.overrides.json`.
